Comments

  • Line 170: A GET request is made with two parameters in the URL;
  • Line 172: After a deletion, the server returns the new list of simulations. This list is returned.

docs.title: The [finSession] method
docs.text:
A work session with the web service normally ends with a call to the [finSession] method:

     // action [fin-session]
     #[\Override]
    public function finSession(): void
    {
         // GET main.php?action=end-session - the response is a simple message
        $this->sendRequest("GET", ["action" => "fin-session"]);
    }

Comments

  • Line 180: A request is made to GET with the single parameter [action]. An exception will be thrown if the response status code HTTP is not 200. The server responds with a new session cookie that the [getResponse] method stores: subsequent requests will be made within the new session, where the user is not authenticated.

docs.title: 23.14.3.1. L'interface
docs.text:
The interface of the [métier] layer is as follows: [Metier/InterfaceClientMetier.php]:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// namespace
namespace Application;

// the interface of the [métier] layer of the JSON web service client, version 12
interface InterfaceClientMetier
{
     // batch tax calculation: the only method specific to the [métier] layer
     // results are saved only if [$resultsFileName] is not null
    public function executeBatchImpots(
        string $taxPayersFileName,
        string $errorsFileName,
        ?string $resultsFileName = null
    ): void;

     // The following methods belong to the [dao] layer
     // Calculation of a taxpayer's tax
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation;

     // Recording the results
     /** @param Simulation[] $simulations */
    public function saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void;

     // Login
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void;

     // authentication
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void;

     // list of simulations
     /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function listerSimulations(): array;

     // Delete a simulation
     /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array;

     // end of session
    public function finSession(): void;
}

Comments

  • line 13: Only the method [executeBatchImpots] is specific to the [métier] layer. All others belong to the [dao] layer, which implements them;
  • Line 16: The results file is optional. If it is missing, the results are not saved. The parameter is of type [?string] (string or [null]). We placed it last: an optional parameter must follow the required parameters. Course PHP 7 declared [string $resultsFileName] and passed [NULL] to the method, which causes a [TypeError]-type error in [strict_types=1] mode.

docs.title: 23.14.3.2. The [ClientMetier] class
docs.text:
The class implementing the [métier] layer is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// namespace
namespace Application;

// the client's [métier] layer: tax calculation is performed by the server
class ClientMetier implements InterfaceClientMetier
{
     // The [dao] layer is injected by the constructor
    public function __construct(private readonly InterfaceClientDao $clientDao)
    {
    }

     // Tax calculation in batch mode
     #[\Override]
    public function executeBatchImpots(
        string $taxPayersFileName,
        string $errorsFileName,
        ?string $resultsFileName = null
    ): void {
         // Exceptions originating from the [dao] layer are allowed to propagate
         // retrieve taxpayer data
        $taxPayersData = $this->clientDao->getTaxPayersData($taxPayersFileName, $errorsFileName);
         // Calculate the tax for each taxpayer: the server stores the simulations in the session
        $simulations = array_map(
            fn(TaxPayerData $taxPayerData): Simulation => $this->calculerImpot(
                $taxPayerData->marié,
                $taxPayerData->enfants,
                $taxPayerData->salaire
            ),
            $taxPayersData
        );
         // Save the results, if requested
        if ($resultsFileName !== null) {
            $this->clientDao->saveResults($resultsFileName, $simulations);
        }
    }

     // other methods delegate the work to the [dao] layer
     #[\Override]
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation
    {
        return $this->clientDao->calculerImpot($marié, $enfants, $salaire);
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->saveResults($resultsFilename, $simulations);
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->initSession($type);
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->authentifierUtilisateur($user, $password);
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function listerSimulations(): array
    {
        return $this->clientDao->listerSimulations();
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array
    {
        return $this->clientDao->supprimerSimulation($numéro);
    }

     #[\Override]
    public function finSession(): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->finSession();
    }
}

Comments

  • line 12: To be instantiated, the [métier] layer requires a reference to the [dao] layer. This reference is injected by the constructor and becomes a read-only attribute through parameter promotion;
  • Lines 18–22: Only the [executeBatchImpots] method is specific to the [métier] layer. The implementations of the other methods delegate the work to the methods of the same names in the [dao] layer;
  • line 25: the [dao] layer is accessed to retrieve taxpayer data into an array of objects of type [TaxPayerData];
  • Lines 27–34: The tax for each taxpayer in the [$taxPayersData] array is calculated. The arrow function (PHP 7.4) called by [array_map] returns, for each taxpayer, the [Simulation] object returned by the server. Each calculation is also stored by the server in the user’s session;
  • lines 36–37: the results are saved to a JSON file only if a filename has been specified.

Note: The [métier] layer does virtually nothing. One might decide to remove it and consolidate everything into the [dao] layer.

docs.title: 23.14.4. The main script
docs.text:
The main script is configured by the following file, [Data/config.json]:

{
    "urlServer": "http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/main.php",
    "user": {
        "login": "admin",
        "passwd": "admin"
    },
    "httpClientOptions": {
        "verify_peer": false,
        "verify_host": false
    },
    "taxPayersDataFilename": "Data/taxpayersdata.json",
    "resultsFilename": "Data/results.json",
    "errorsFilename": "Data/errors.json",
    "dependencies": [
        "../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php",
        "../version-05/Entities/TaxPayerData.php",
        "../version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php",
        "../version-05/Dao/TraitDao.php",
        "../../../scripts-web/impots/version-12/Entities/Simulation.php",
        "Dao/InterfaceClientDao.php",
        "Dao/ClientDao.php",
        "Metier/InterfaceClientMetier.php",
        "Metier/ClientMetier.php"
    ]
}
  • Line 2: the URL for the main server controller in version 12. We use the [http] schema, as we have since version 8 (see the section “Why [http] and not [https]?” in the chapter on version 8);
  • line 3: the user’s credentials;
  • line 7: the HTTP client options, already used by the Version 11 client: if URL uses the [https] schema, the server’s self-signed certificate is not verified;
  • Lines 14–24: The application files to be loaded, related to the client's [version-12] folder. This includes the server’s [Simulation] class. Course PHP 7 also provided an absolute root directory, [rootDirectory], and the absolute path to the Composer autoloader. As with previous versions, the paths are now calculated based on the constant [__DIR__]: the [php8-oct-2026] folder can be moved without changing the configuration.

The main script [Main/main.php] is as follows:

<?php

// Strict adherence to the declared types of function parameters and return values
declare(strict_types=1);

// namespace
namespace Application;

// the client's root directory: paths to the configuration file are relative to this directory
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// Configuration file path
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json";

// Retrieve the configuration
$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILENAME), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

// Include the dependencies required by the script: third-party libraries (Symfony) followed by application files
require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
foreach ($config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
    require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
}

// paths to the data files
$taxPayersDataFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["taxPayersDataFilename"];
$resultsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["resultsFilename"];
$errorsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["errorsFilename"];

// creating the [dao] layer—server responses will be displayed (verbose)
$clientDao = new ClientDao($config["urlServer"], $config["httpClientOptions"], verbose: true);
// creation of the layer [métier]
$clientMetier = new ClientMetier($clientDao);

// A complete dialogue with the web service JSON
try {
     // initializing a session JSON
    $clientMetier->initSession("json");
     // authentication
    $clientMetier->authentifierUtilisateur($config["user"]["login"], $config["user"]["passwd"]);
     // Calculating taxes in batch mode without saving the results (no parameter [resultsFileName])
    $clientMetier->executeBatchImpots(
        taxPayersFileName: $taxPayersDataFilename,
        errorsFileName: $errorsFilename
    );
     // list of simulations
    $clientMetier->listerSimulations();
     // Delete simulation #1 (the second one on the list)
    $simulations = $clientMetier->supprimerSimulation(1);
     // Save the remaining simulations
    $clientMetier->saveResults($resultsFilename, $simulations);
    print count($simulations) . " simulations ont été enregistrées dans le fichier [{$config["resultsFilename"]}]\n";
     // end of session
    $clientMetier->finSession();
     // Action in the new session, where the user is not authenticated: must fail
    $clientMetier->listerSimulations();
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
     // The error is displayed
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// end
print "Terminé\n";

Comments

  • lines 10–15: processing the configuration file [config.json];
  • lines 18–20: loading all dependencies;
  • lines 24–26: absolute paths to the data files;
  • lines 29–31: building the layers [dao] and [métier]. The parameter [$verbose] is passed by name: [verbose: true] is more descriptive than simply [true];
  • line 36: initialization of a JSON session;
  • line 38: authenticating with the server;
  • lines 40–43: calculating the tax for a group of taxpayers. The results are not saved: thanks to named arguments, we simply omit the optional parameter [resultsFileName];
  • line 45: the results of all these calculations are retrieved;
  • line 47: delete simulation #1 (the second one on the list);
  • line 49: Save the remaining simulations;
  • line 52: the session is ended. The server deletes the session and starts a new one;
  • line 54: the list of simulations is requested. In the new session, the user is not authenticated. Therefore, an exception should occur indicating that the user is not authenticated.

docs.title: 23.14.5. [PHPUnit] Tests
docs.text:
As with previous clients, the Version 12 client can be tested using [PHPUnit]. The test class [Tests/ClientMetierTest.php] is similar to that of previous clients:

<?php

// Strict adherence to the declared types of parameters and function return values
declare(strict_types=1);

// Test namespace
namespace Application\Tests;

// The classes being tested
use Application\ClientDao;
use Application\ClientMetier;
use Application\ExceptionImpots;
use Application\InterfaceClientMetier;
use Application\Simulation;
// the classes in PHPUnit
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

// Testing the [métier] layer of the JSON web service client: the server must be running
final class ClientMetierTest extends TestCase
{
     // the client's root directory
    private const string ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
     // client configuration
    private static array $config;
     // The [métier] layer tested
    private InterfaceClientMetier $métier;

     // run once, before the first test in the class
     #[\Override]
    public static function setUpBeforeClass(): void
    {
         // retrieving the client configuration
        self::$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json"), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
         // includes client dependencies (the Composer loader is already loaded by PHPUnit)
        foreach (self::$config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
            require_once self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
        }
    }

     // run before each test: each test has its own authenticated JSON session
     #[\Override]
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
         // creation of layers [dao] (non-verbose) and [métier]
        $clientDao = new ClientDao(self::$config["urlServer"], self::$config["httpClientOptions"], verbose: false);
        $this->métier = new ClientMetier($clientDao);
         // initializing a session JSON
        $this->métier->initSession("json");
         // authentication
        $this->métier->authentifierUtilisateur(self::$config["user"]["login"], self::$config["user"]["passwd"]);
    }

     // Taxpayers in the table of official figures
    public static function contribuables(): array
    {
         // [marié, enfants, salaire, impôt officiel, [impôt, surcôte, décôte, réduction, taux] attendus]
        return [
            "couple, 2 enfants, 55555" => ["oui", 2, 55555, 2815, [2814, 0, 0, 0, 0.14]],
            "couple, 2 enfants, 50000" => ["oui", 2, 50000, 1385, [1384, 0, 384, 347, 0.14]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 50000" => ["oui", 3, 50000, 0, [0, 0, 720, 0, 0.14]],
            "célibataire, 2 enfants, 100000" => ["non", 2, 100000, 19884, [19884, 4480, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "célibataire, 3 enfants, 100000" => ["non", 3, 100000, 16782, [16782, 7176, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 100000" => ["oui", 3, 100000, 9200, [9200, 2180, 0, 0, 0.3]],
            "couple, 5 enfants, 100000" => ["oui", 5, 100000, 4230, [4230, 0, 0, 0, 0.14]],
            "célibataire, 0 enfant, 100000" => ["non", 0, 100000, 22986, [22986, 0, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "couple, 2 enfants, 30000" => ["oui", 2, 30000, 0, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0]],
            "célibataire, 0 enfant, 200000" => ["non", 0, 200000, 64211, [64210, 7498, 0, 0, 0.45]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 200000" => ["oui", 3, 200000, 42843, [42842, 17283, 0, 0, 0.41]],
        ];
    }

     // a test run once for each taxpayer of the data provider
     #[DataProvider("contribuables")]
    public function testCalculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire, int $impôtOfficiel, array $attendu): void
    {
         // tax calculation
        $simulation = $this->métier->calculerImpot($marié, $enfants, $salaire);
         // The tax amount matches that of the official simulator to within 1 euro
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta($impôtOfficiel, $simulation->impôt, 1);
         // The simulation is exactly as expected: [assertEquals] compares the attributes of the two objects
        $this->assertEquals(new Simulation($marié, $enfants, $salaire, ...$attendu), $simulation);
    }

     // the actions [lister-simulations] and [supprimer-simulation]
    public function testListerSupprimerSimulations(): void
    {
         // two simulations in a new session
        $this->métier->calculerImpot("oui", 2, 55555);
        $this->métier->calculerImpot("non", 0, 100000);
        $this->assertCount(2, $this->métier->listerSimulations());
         // the first one was deleted: the second one remains
        $simulations = $this->métier->supprimerSimulation(0);
        $this->assertCount(1, $simulations);
        $this->assertSame(22986, $simulations[0]->impôt);
         // Simulation #1 no longer exists: status 628, status HTTP 400
        $this->assertErreur(400, 628, fn() => $this->métier->supprimerSimulation(1));
    }

     // After the session ends, the user is no longer authenticated
    public function testFinSession(): void
    {
        $this->métier->finSession();
         // status 104: action requested by an unauthenticated user
        $this->assertErreur(400, 104, fn() => $this->métier->listerSimulations());
    }

     // Verifies that the action [$action] throws an exception [ExceptionImpots] with code 42
     // whose message JSON contains the expected status HTTP
    private function assertErreur(int $statutHttp, int $état, \Closure $action): void
    {
        try {
            $action();
            $this->fail("une exception [ExceptionImpots] était attendue");
        } catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
            $this->assertSame(42, $ex->getCode());
            $erreur = json_decode($ex->getMessage(), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $this->assertSame($statutHttp, $erreur["statut HTTP"]);
            $this->assertSame($état, $erreur["état"]);
        }
    }
}

Comments

  • lines 31–37: The client configuration is read and dependencies are loaded only once, before the first test;
  • Lines 43–51: Note that the [setUp] method is executed before each test. It constructs the layers [dao] (in non-verbose mode) and [métier], then initializes a session JSON and authenticates itself. Each test thus runs in its own session, independent of the other tests. Course PHP 7 performed this task in the test class constructor, which PHPUnit no longer allows;
  • lines 55–69: the data provider from previous versions. For each taxpayer, we have the tax calculated by the official simulator and the five expected results from [impôt, surcôte, décôte, réduction, taux];
  • line 82: the expected simulation is constructed and compared to the one returned by the server. When applied to two objects, the [assertEquals] method verifies that they are of the same class and that their attributes are equal. The operator [...] decomposes a list here: its elements are passed to the last five parameters of the constructor, in order;
  • Lines 86–97: A test of the actions [lister-simulations] and [supprimer-simulation]. We run two simulations, delete the first one, and verify that the second one remains. Then we request the deletion of a simulation that does not exist: the server must respond with status 628;
  • lines 101–105: After the session ends, the list of simulations must be rejected with status code 104;
  • lines 110–119: a utility method that verifies that the action [$action], passed as an anonymous function, throws a [ExceptionImpots] exception with code 42, the expected status HTTP, and the expected status. Since the exception message is the server’s JSON response, it is decoded to verify its elements. If no exception is thrown, the [fail] method causes the test to fail.

The test results are as follows:

docs.title: 24. Practical Exercise – Version 13
docs.text: Version 13 introduces few changes: it secures access to the application’s files. It adds no new features: the actions, the responses JSON, XML, and HTML, and the views are the same as in version 12. What has changed is the file structure on the disk and the configuration of the [Apache] server.

docs.title: 24.1. The Problem
docs.text:
In Course PHP 7, you could request the URL configuration file from Version 12, and the browser would display it. However, this [config.json] file contains sensitive information, such as the credentials of users authorized to use the application. It must not be accessible to users.

In our version 12, this file is already protected: it is located in the [Data] folder, to which the [.htaccess] file—introduced with version 8—denies access ([Require all denied] directive). However, this protection is applied on a case-by-case basis: we block only what we’ve specifically chosen to block, and everything else is served. Yet there are still many things that should not be displayed. For example, the browser may request a view directly, without going through the main controller:

> curl -i http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache/2.4.58
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Vary: Accept-Encoding
Content-Length: 1011
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

<br />
<b>Warning</b>:  Undefined variable $request in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>9</b><br />
<br />
<b>Warning</b>:  Undefined variable $content in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>9</b><br />
<br />
<b>Fatal error</b>:  Uncaught TypeError: getModelForThisView(): Argument #1 ($request) must be of type Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request; null was provided; called in .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php on line 9 and defined in .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php:11
Stack trace:
#0 .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php(9): getModelForThisView(NULL, NULL)
#1 {main}
  thrown in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>11</b><br />

The view is executed out of context: the variables normally provided by the [HtmlResponse] class do not exist. Since [Laragon] is configured for development (directive [display_errors=On] from PHP), error messages are sent to the browser. They reveal the file paths on the server, as well as the names of the functions and classes used—all of which is useful information for anyone seeking to attack the application. Secondary controllers, response classes, and the classes in the [métier] and [dao] layers can likewise be executed by a simple URL. Here, they merely define a class, but there is no guarantee that this will always be the case.

More seriously: the entire [php8-oct-2026] folder for the course is located inside the [www] folder of [Laragon]. The console script files are also accessible via the web, even though no one thought to protect them:

> curl -i http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-console/impots/version-05/Data/database.json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache/2.4.58
Last-Modified: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:46:08 GMT
ETag: "3c6-65cc950791217"
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Content-Length: 966
Content-Type: application/json

{
    "dsn": "mysql:host=localhost;dbname=dbimpots-2019;charset=utf8mb4",
    "id": "admimpots",
    "pwd": "mdpimpots",
    "tableTranches": "tbtranches",
    "colId": "id",
    "colLimites": "limites",
    "colCoeffR": "coeffr",
    "colCoeffN": "coeffn",
    "tableConstantes": "tbconstantes",
    "colPlafondQfDemiPart": "plafondQfDemiPart",
    "colPlafondRevenusCelibatairePourReduction": "plafondRevenusCelibatairePourReduction",
    "colPlafondRevenusCouplePourReduction": "plafondRevenusCouplePourReduction",
    "colValeurReducDemiPart": "valeurReducDemiPart",
    "colPlafondDecoteCelibataire": "plafondDecoteCelibataire",
    "colPlafondDecoteCouple": "plafondDecoteCouple",
    "colPlafondImpotCelibatairePourDecote": "plafondImpotCelibatairePourDecote",
    "colPlafondImpotCouplePourDecote": "plafondImpotCouplePourDecote",
    "colAbattementDixPourcentMax": "abattementDixPourcentMax",
    "colAbattementDixPourcentMin": "abattementDixPourcentMin"
}

Anyone can read the username and password for the [dbimpots-2019] database user. However, server versions 8 through 12 use this file or its equivalent.

The correct approach is the opposite: block everything by default, then explicitly allow only what needs to be accessible from the outside. For our application, only three files need to be accessible:

  • [main.php], the main controller, which receives all requests;
  • [index.php], the entry point for the application HTML, which redirects to [main.php];
  • the image [logo.jpg], which the browser requests via a HTTP request when it displays the view banner.

docs.title: 24.2. The new directory structure
docs.text:
We copy and paste the [scripts-web/impots/version-12] folder into [scripts-web/impots/version-13], then reorganize its files:

scripts-web/impots/version-13
├── .htaccess
├── Config
│   ├── config.json
│   ├── database.json
│   └── vhost-impots-v13.conf
├── Controllers
│   └── (les contrôleurs secondaires de la version 12)
├── Entities
│   ├── Action.php
│   ├── ControllerResult.php
│   ├── Database.php
│   ├── ExceptionImpots.php
│   ├── ResponseType.php
│   ├── Simulation.php
│   └── TaxAdminData.php
├── Logs
│   └── logs.txt
├── Model
│   ├── InterfaceServerDao.php
│   ├── InterfaceServerMetier.php
│   ├── ServerDao.php
│   ├── ServerDaoWithSession.php
│   └── ServerMetier.php
├── Responses
│   └── (les classes des réponses de la version 12)
├── Utilities
│   ├── Logger.php
│   ├── SendAdminMail.php
│   ├── Utilitaires.php
│   └── XmlUtilitaires.php
├── Views
│   └── (les vues de la version 12, sans le logo)
└── public
    ├── Resources
    │   └── logo.jpg
    ├── index.php
    └── main.php
  • into [public], the only folder that will be accessible via the web. It contains the two scripts [index.php, main.php] and, in the [Resources] folder, the image [logo.jpg]. The name [public] is the one used by current PHP frameworks (Symfony, Laravel) for this same role;
  • In [Config], the configuration files: [config.json] (formerly [Data/config.json]) and [database.json], and the database configuration that was taken from the [Data] folder in version 8. The file [vhost-impots-v13.conf] will be presented at the end of the chapter;
  • in [Logs], the log file, which was in the [Data] folder;
  • and in [Model], the layer classes [métier] and [dao] from the server. Until now, they were loaded from the version 8 and 9 folders. They have now been copied to the version 13 folder, along with the features [ExceptionImpots, TaxAdminData, Database] (version 5) and the utilities [Logger, SendAdminMail] (version 9), [XmlUtilitaires] (version 11), and [Utilitaires] (version 5). The [version-13] folder thus contains the entire application: this is the only folder that would be copied to a production server, without relying on folders from other versions;
  • the [Tests] folder from version 12, which contained the test pages for the views, is not included: these pages would no longer be accessible via the web anyway.

The names of these files do not change, nor does their content, with three exceptions that we will now discuss. Only the Composer library [vendor] remains in its original location, at the root of the [php8-oct-2026] folder.

docs.title: 24.3.2. The main controller [public/main.php]
docs.text:
The main controller has been moved to the [public] folder. Only two lines have changed:

// Errors from PHP are not sent to the client (they go to the web server log)
ini_set("display_errors", "0");

// the application root directory, parent of the [public] directory: the paths in the configuration file are relative to this directory
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// Configuration file path
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Config/config.json";

// the Composer autoloader (Symfony, Predis)
require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
  • Line 18: The constant [ROOT_DIRECTORY] still refers to the application’s root folder, relative to which the paths in the [config.json] file are defined. Since the script is now in the [public] folder, this root folder is the parent folder of [__DIR__]. You cannot write [dirname(__DIR__)]: the value of a constant declared with [const] must be a constant expression, and a function call is not one. The concatenation of [__DIR__] (a constant) and a string is a constant expression;
  • line 20: the new path to the configuration file;
  • line 23: this line does not change: the path to the Composer loader is relative to the application’s root directory, which is always [scripts-web/impots/version-13].

The script [public/index.php] is the one from version 12. Its redirection to the relative path URL via [main.php?action=init-session&type=html] remains correct since [index.php] and [main.php] are in the same folder.

        </div>

</div>
  • Line 9: The logo's URL is related to the URL of the displayed page, which is always that of the main controller, [.../version-13/public/main.php]. The browser will therefore request the URL and [.../version-13/public/Resources/logo.jpg].

docs.title: 24.4. The application’s [.htaccess] file
docs.text:
With [Laragon], the document root of the [Apache] server ([DocumentRoot] directive) is the [www] folder. Therefore, everything under [www] can be accessed by a URL, and in particular the entire [version-13] folder. To restrict access to everything not contained in the [public] folder, we use a single [.htaccess] file, located at the root of the application, within the [version-13] folder. Note that the directives in a [.htaccess] file apply to the folder containing it and all its subfolders. [Laragon] configures [Apache] to read these files ([AllowOverride All] directive):

# version 13: only the application's [public] folder is accessible via the web
# (Apache 2.4—the [mod_rewrite] module must be enabled, which is the case with Laragon)

# no list of folder contents
Options -Indexes

# rewriting of URL: patterns are compared to the path of the URL relative to the [version-13] folder
RewriteEngine On
# The URL file in the application folder [.../version-13/] is redirected to the folder [public]
# %1: the path of the requested URL, without the trailing /, captured by the condition [RewriteCond]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^(.*)/$
RewriteRule ^$ %1/public/ [R=302,L]
# Any other URL that does not refer to the [public] directory or one of its files is denied (403 Forbidden)
RewriteRule !^public(/|$) - [F]

Comments

  • Line 5: When a URL specifies a folder that does not have a default document ([index.php], [index.html]), [Apache] can display the list of files in the folder. The [Options -Indexes] directive prevents this;
  • Line 8: We use the [mod_rewrite] module from [Apache], the rewriting module for URL, which is enabled by default in [Laragon]. A [RewriteRule] rule has the form [RewriteRule motif substitution [options]]. In a [.htaccess] file, the pattern—a regular expression—is compared to the path of the requested URL relative to the directory of the [.htaccess] file. For URL and [http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-13/Config/config.json], this path is [Config/config.json];
  • Lines 11–12: The first rule processes the URL file from the [.../version-13/] application folder, whose relative path is empty (reason: [^$]). It redirects the browser (option [R=302]) to the [public] folder and stops processing the rules (option [L], for “last”). The substitution must be a complete URL path: it is obtained from the variable [REQUEST_URI] of [Apache], the path of the requested URL [/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-13/]. The condition [RewriteCond] preceding the rule compares this variable to the regular expression [^(.*)/$]: the portion in parentheses—the path without the trailing /—is then available in the rule under the name [%1]. Thus, the file [.htaccess] does not depend on the application’s location in the [www] folder;
  • Line 14: The second rule applies to any URL whose relative path does not begin with [public/] and is not exactly [public]: this is the meaning of the [!] placed before the pattern. The substitution [-] means “no substitution,” and the option [F] (for “forbidden”) causes [Apache] to be mapped to the code [403 Forbidden]. The URL [.../version-13/public], without the trailing /, must remain allowed: [Apache] (module [mod_dir]) responds to it with a redirect to [.../version-13/public/].

This file also blocks access to itself: it is not located in the [public] folder. Since the path to a URL is normalized to [Apache] before the rules are applied, a URL—like a [.../version-13/public/../Config/config.json]—is also denied.

The PHP 7 course placed a [.htaccess] file containing the two lines [order deny,allow] and [deny from all] in each of the folders to be protected. This is the syntax of [Apache] 2.2. [Apache] 2.4 now accepts it only through the [mod_access_compat] compatibility module, which is scheduled to be phased out. The syntax for [Apache] 2.4 is [Require all denied], which we have been using since version 8.

If you do not want to use the [mod_rewrite] module, one possible alternative uses two [.htaccess] files and the [Require] syntax:

  • in the [version-13] folder, a file named [.htaccess] containing only the line [Require all denied]: everything is prohibited;
  • in the [public] folder, a file named [.htaccess] containing only the line [Require all granted]: the permission settings of a subfolder override those of the parent folder, and all content in [public] is permitted.

This variant also works, but the URL [.../version-13/] is then denied access instead of being redirected to the [public] folder.

docs.text:
Application files outside the [public] folder are rejected:

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden

Content-Length: 5136
